summary: Read the full public Carneades survey article and About page, with precise section locators and rejected readings preserved in docs/notes/carneades-epistemology-introspection.md. The survey distinguishes not knowing justification from no justification, and certainty from knowledge; later prose sometimes suppresses these qualifications. No attributed claim or source manifest is created. Existing regress/schema and retorsion results already cover graph-level and universal-ignorance controls. New independent relational profile composes axiom4_valid with a global knowledge-requires-justification norm and gives a reflexive nontransitive three-world model where knowledge and justification coexist with higher-order ignorance. This neither refutes scepticism nor establishes any actual knowledge; foundationalist, coherentist and infinitist justification standards remain open. Root premise delta zero.
